name: WavCaps
description: A large-scale weakly-labelled audio captioning dataset with approximately 400k audio clips paired with captions, created using a three-stage pipeline leveraging ChatGPT to filter and generate high-quality captions for audio-language multimodal research.
reputation: WavCaps is a widely used large-scale audio captioning dataset in audio-language research and is commonly used for pretraining and evaluation.
notes: Addresses data scarcity in audio-language tasks by using weakly-labelled data and LLM-based filtering; enables improved performance on downstream audio-language tasks.
